screenshot_review: Every assigned title and complete ItemBody was reviewed against its matching frozen local HTML and individual original-resolution screenshot tile(s). All 257 PNGs were opened individually with tools.view_image; no collage or downscaled view was used. Sequential fixed-height screenshot boundaries were followed across all tiles.

rendering_findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** read the vanishing of $h^1$ off the vanishing theorem, substitute it into the Euler-characteristic form of Riemann-Roch, and record the explicit form $D_0+nA+E$.
rendering_findings.symptom: In the proof-technique banner the inline math delimiters and expressions are printed literally (including $h^1$ and $D_0+nA+E$), while the same notation in the proof body is typeset. This makes math formatting depend on which proof section contains the prose. The issue recurs in several assigned items, including ex-adding-point-section-dimension-jump line 127 (\mathbb P^1_k), thm-hilbert-polynomial-coherent-sheaf line 126 (\chi(\mathcal F(m))), and lem-schematic-closure-and-dense-agreement line 218.
rendering_findings.suggested_repair: Render the proof-technique prose through the same math-aware renderer as other ItemBody prose, while retaining its label styling.

rendering_findings.symptom: The trailing \qed command appears as literal text at the end of the rendered proof. The same leak is present in ex-proj-quotient-projective-hypersurface line 56 and lem-projective-space-saturation-local-criterion line 82; their final tiles were also individually inspected.
rendering_findings.suggested_repair: Replace the unsupported text command with the renderer’s supported proof-ending marker or remove it when the card supplies its own end marker.

optional_typography.observation: The title uses plain-text l(D+p) - l(D), while the statement and proof use typeset mathematical notation. This is a title typography observation only.

existing_diagram_checks.check: The displayed cotangent sequence has arrows f*ΩY/S → ΩX/S → ΩX/Y → 0; the proof identifies γ as the first map, δ as the second, verifies im γ = ker δ, and gives a counterexample to injectivity. The diagram directions match the statement.
The local chart ratios x_j^(i) = x_j/x_i and the maps to/from generating line-bundle data agree with the stated universal property and naturality.
The adjunction direction is Hom_OX(f*G,F) ≅ Hom_OY(G,f_*F), matching the maps constructed in the proof.

diagram_review: No TikZ or tikzcd source diagrams occur in the 109 assigned items. Existing inline map data and exact-sequence arrows listed above were checked for direction and consistency. The proof bodies provide concrete algebraic maps/relations where diagrams might otherwise be considered; no additional high-likelihood missing diagram was found.
clipping: No confirmed clipping. All 257 screenshot tiles were inspected individually at original resolution; content that continues across tall-item capture boundaries resumes in later assigned tiles.
reference_titles: Wikilink reference titles generally render as separate block lines within the captured card layout. No reference-title leak or unexpected item-ID text was observed beyond the item identifier header.
technique_banners: Technique banners use uppercase styling in the capture. The confirmed rendering issue is that mathematical delimiters in proof-technique prose are not typeset in at least some banners; this is reported above.
limitations: Local frozen sources, snapshots, static HTML and screenshots only; no live website or network inspection.
